products.name: Le Mans Rooftop Ventilator
products.tagline: The 850 m³/h benchmark in vehicle ventilation
products.summary: The most popular electric roof fan for ambulances, horse trucks, buses and commercial vehicles. 850 m³/h of suction or blowing power under a streamlined cover, available in 12V and 24V, white or black.
description: The Le Mans is where style meets raw airflow. A sleek, low-profile cover (only 64 mm above the roof, so it sits happily next to solar panels) hides a motor that moves 850 m³/h in either direction: suck hot, humid or contaminated air out, or blow fresh air in. It is the ventilator that bodybuilders across Europe specify when a vehicle simply has to stay fresh.

Choose 12V for vans, campers and passenger vehicles, or 24V for trucks, coaches and buses. Both versions are EMC approved, so they will not interfere with your vehicle electronics. Prefer a passive solution? The motorless version uses the same 230 mm roof cut-out and can be upgraded to electric later.
Finish the installation with a 3-way switch (blow / off / suck), an optional speed controller and one of our interior valves or grilles. Everything fits the same 230 mm opening.
features: Only 52 dB(A) at full speed, quieter with speed control
Low profile: 64 mm above the roof, 385 x 312 mm footprint
Streamlined ABS roof ring with PA6 cover, 1.3 kg
Roof opening 230 mm (245 mm with ring)
EMC approved motor, test report available

specs.Accessories: Switch, speed control, interior valve, snow filter

faq.q: How large does the roof opening need to be?
faq.a: A 230 mm hole. The roof ring covers up to 245 mm, so a slightly oversized cut is no problem.
At full speed the Le Mans measures 52 dB(A). Add the optional speed controller to run it quietly at a fraction of the speed, which most camper and ambulance users do at night.
The Le Mans is designed to shrug off heavy rain in normal use. For extreme conditions, add the snow filter, which also keeps out insects.
12V for passenger cars, vans and most campers; 24V for trucks, coaches and buses. Check your vehicle's system voltage before ordering.

Cut a 230 mm hole, protect the edge against corrosion, point the arrow on the ring in the driving direction and bond the ring with an MS polymer adhesive or screw it through the eight rim holes. Fit the interior grille or valve before wiring.

products.name: Le Mans LL Brushless Rooftop Ventilator
products.tagline: Brushless. Longer life. Lower draw.
products.summary: The long-life version of the Le Mans. A brushless motor pulls 515 to 565 m³/h of air out of your vehicle at only 34 W, with no brushes to wear out. Ideal for damp loading areas, animal transport, chemical transport and coaches.
description: The Le Mans LL takes the proven Le Mans shape and fits it with a brushless motor. The result: a ventilator that runs for years without servicing, draws only 34 W and is available with an integrated speed control unit.

The LL is an extraction-only ventilator, which is exactly what most loading areas, animal compartments and coach toilets need: a constant, healthy discharge of humid or contaminated air. Pair it with a floor ventilator for a complete airflow loop.
Order the 12V or 24V version, with or without built-in speed control. A 3-way switch and interior valve are available separately. Saw template included.
features: Grey ABS roof ring, white PA6 cover
Roof opening 230 mm, EMC approved, saw template included

specs.Materials: ABS roof ring (grey), PA6 cover (white RAL 9010)

faq.q: What is the difference with the standard Le Mans?
faq.a: The LL uses a brushless motor (longer life, lower power draw) and extracts only. The standard Le Mans can blow and suck and moves more air (850 m³/h).
Yes. Choose the version with integrated speed control unit, or add our separate Speedcontrol 30-3004.

products.name: Round Rooftop Ventilator
products.tagline: 850 m³/h in a classic round housing
products.summary: The same 850 m³/h motor as the Le Mans in a round ABS housing, only 62 mm high. Blow and suck with the 3-way switch, reduce noise with a speed controller. Loved in campers, caravans, trailers, houseboats and loading areas.
description: Our round electric rooftop ventilator delivers a healthy supply and exhaust of air in commercial vehicles, campers and cars. It shares the Le Mans motor platform (850 m³/h, 80 W) but uses a round Ø 320 mm cover, just 62 mm high, that suits many classic vehicle roofs and fits under most roof racks.
Use the 3-position switch to choose intake or extraction, and add the speed controller to dial the airflow (and the noise) down when you only need a trickle of fresh air overnight.
Available in 12V and 24V, white or black, and as a motorless version that can be motorised later. The cover can be painted in your body colour.
features: Round Ø 320 mm cover, only 62 mm high
ABS / PA6 housing, white or black, IP68 motor
Optional: switch, speed control, interior valve, snow filter

faq.q: Le Mans or Round: which should I pick?
faq.a: Technically identical (850 m³/h, 80 W). The Le Mans has a lower, more aerodynamic cover; the Round suits classic roofs and tight spaces. Both use a 230 mm opening.

products.name: Winglet Mini Roof Fan
products.tagline: 3 watts. 80 mm hole. Silent extraction.
products.summary: A tiny electric extractor for small vans, camper kitchens, caravans, dog boxes and toilet compartments. 65 m³/h through an 80 mm cut-out at just 3 W, complete with interior grille, open/close frame and saw template.
description: The Winglet is our answer for spaces where a full-size roof fan is overkill: a VW Caddy, the kitchen of a motorhome, a caravan washroom or an equipment locker. It pulls 65 m³/h of stale air out at only 3 W, so it can run all night on a leisure battery.

Installation is a single 80 mm hole. The unit comes complete with interior grille, an open/close valve and a saw template, and the low-profile cover (230 x 196 mm, 52 mm high) sits well below most roof racks.
Available in white or black, electric (12V) or motorless.
features: Complete with open/close frame, interior grille and template
Footprint 230 x 196 mm, 52 mm high, approx. 0.5 kg
Mounting set for roof thickness 1 to 17 mm
White or black ABS, EMC approved

faq.a: Yes, a simple on/off or one of our 3-way switches. The Winglet extracts only, so you will use just one position.

products.name: Turbo II Wind-Driven Rooftop Ventilator
products.tagline: Zero watts. Ventilates every time you drive.
products.summary: A rotating, wind-powered extractor that keeps pulling stale air out of your van, dog transporter or horse trailer without a single wire. Around 245 m³/h at motorway speed. Ø 319 mm cowl, 128 mm cut-out, only 68 mm high so it fits under most roof racks.
description: The Turbo II is the classic mushroom-style rotating vent, refined. Airflow over the roof spins the UV-stabilised ABS cowl on two ball bearings and a venturi effect pulls air out of the vehicle: roughly 245 m³/h at 100 km/h. No wiring, no power draw, no noise. It simply works whenever the vehicle moves or the wind blows.

At 68 mm high it fits under most roof racks. The 128 mm bore hole and 26 mm installation depth make it an easy retrofit, and the kit includes an interior grille and closable shutter so you can shut it off in winter.
Perfect for transporting dogs, horses and cargo that must not sit in stale air. Combine it with a floor ventilator for a continuous flow even when parked.
features: Ø 319 mm rotating cowl, 2 ball bearings, UV-stabilised ABS
Roof cut-out 128 mm, depth 26 mm, height 68 mm
Interior grille and closable shutter included
Mounting set for roof thickness 1 to 21 mm

faq.a: Only when there is wind. For guaranteed airflow when stationary, choose an electric model such as the Le Mans or Winglet, or combine the Turbo II with a floor ventilator for natural convection.

products.name: Turbo III Compact Wind-Driven Ventilator
products.tagline: The little brother: 80 mm hole, no glue
products.summary: The compact version of the Turbo II. Ø 210 mm cowl, 80 mm cut-out, 59.5 mm high, around 120 m³/h at motorway speed, complete with open/close valve. Snaps together without glue. For boats, dog boxes, small vans and coach compartments.
description: The Turbo III is a smaller wind-driven ventilator for spaces where every millimetre counts. It needs just an 80 mm hole, stands 59.5 mm tall and slides under almost any roof rack.

Like its bigger brother it spins on two ball bearings and extracts air by venturi effect (roughly 120 m³/h at 100 km/h), but it assembles in minutes and requires no glue. The inside is finished with a stylish grille and an open/close valve.
Ideal for venting boats, dog transporters, small service vans, caravans and coaches. Made in Holland.
features: Ø 210 mm cowl, only 59.5 mm high
Complete with interior grille and open/close valve
Mounting set for roof thickness 1 to 17 mm

products.name: Exhaust Ventilator (Venturi)
products.tagline: Aerodynamic, silent, no moving parts
products.summary: A low, aerodynamic ABS vent (285 x 185 mm, 50 mm high) that uses the venturi effect to pull air out of your van while driving. No motor, no moving parts, practically inaudible. Often combined with a powered roof fan or used stand-alone.
description: The mechanical exhaust ventilator is the simplest way to keep a commercial vehicle fresh: wind passing over the cover pulls air from the cargo area below. No power, no maintenance, no noise, and it keeps working with a light breeze even when parked.

Thanks to its 50 mm height it works under roof racks, and because it needs no wiring the installation is quick: cut a hole of up to 140 mm, bond with body sealant (never silicone) and fit the interior grille. Combine it with our floor ventilator for a steady supply of fresh air, or pair it with an electric roof fan for forced ventilation when parked.
Available in white or black. Finish the inside with the 35-3003 rotary valve or the Ø 140 mm ABS grille.
features: Venturi effect extraction, no power needed
No mechanical moving parts, practically silent
Low aerodynamic profile: 285 x 185 mm, 50 mm high
ABS, white or black, only 0.5 kg
Interior finish: rotary valve 35-3003 or grille 35-26xx

products.name: V12 Interior Ventilation Valve
products.tagline: The closable ceiling valve for the Le Mans
products.summary: Ø 290 mm ABS ceiling valve that finishes the inside of your Le Mans or Round rooftop ventilator. Adjustable louvres prevent draughts; open it for full airflow, close it in winter. Manual or electric (12/24V), in white, grey or dark grey.
description: The V12 is the interior valve most customers pair with the Le Mans. It covers the 230 mm roof opening with a clean Ø 290 mm louvre (only 20 mm high) that you can open and close by hand, or electrically from your dashboard with the 12/24V version. It also acts as a finger guard for the fan blades.

Made from high-quality ABS, it is a statement piece rather than just a functional cover. Three colour combinations let it blend into any interior: white, grey or dark grey. Designed for vehicles with a headliner or ceiling.
Tip: order the electric version together with a Le Mans and a 3-way switch for a fully remote-controlled ventilation system.
features: Ø 290 mm, covers the 230 mm roof opening
Open and close the airflow, adjustable louvres
Fits Le Mans, Le Mans LL and Round rooftop ventilators

faq.q: Does it fit the Le Mans?
faq.a: Yes. The V12 is designed for the 230 mm opening of the Le Mans, Le Mans LL and Round rooftop ventilators.

products.name: Flower Power Interior Valve
products.tagline: Closable Ø 280 mm valve, optionally with LED light
products.summary: A luxurious closable ceiling grille (Ø 280 mm) for vehicles with a ceiling. Maintains maximum airflow, opens and closes by hand, and is available with 21 white + 9 blue LEDs in 12V or 24V.
description: Flower Power is our design interior valve: a Ø 280 mm closable grille with a distinctive radial pattern that looks as good in a luxury horsebox as in a camper. It keeps the full airflow of your roof ventilator while letting you shut it off completely.
Choose the plain version in white, light grey or light grey with dark grey accent, or the LED version with 21 white and 9 blue LEDs for courtesy and night lighting, in 12V or 24V.
Designed for vehicles with a canopy or ceiling. No ceiling? Choose a standard grille instead.
features: Optional LED: 21 white + 9 blue LEDs, 12V or 24V
White, light grey or two-tone grey

specs.Colours: White, Light grey, Light grey / Dark grey
specs.Compatible with: Le Mans, Le Mans LL, Round rooftop ventilators

products.name: Rotating Interior Valve Ø 300 mm
products.tagline: Classic rotating valve in black, white or grey
products.summary: A Ø 300 mm rotating ceiling valve that opens and closes with a twist. Available in black, white or grey, and with an integrated 12/24V light. Optional micro-switch stops the ventilator when the valve is closed.
description: Our rotating valve is the timeless interior finish for roof ventilators: twist to open, twist to close. At Ø 300 mm it fully covers the 230 mm roof opening of our Le Mans and Round ventilators.
Pick sleek black, timeless white or contemporary grey to match your interior, or choose the white version with integrated 12V/24V light for courtesy lighting.

Use it with the 02-1030 exhaust ventilator (and the older 02-1026 / 02-1027 models) for a complete, closable passive ventilation system.

products.tagline: Polished aluminium, five diameters
products.summary: A rotating ventilation valve crafted from lightweight polished metal. From Ø 130 mm to Ø 250 mm, for commercial vehicles, horse trucks, boats and public vehicles that deserve a premium interior detail.
description: When plastic is not enough. Our light-metal rotary valve is polished to a mirror finish and rotates to regulate the airflow. A functional necessity turned into a stylish detail for horse trucks, boats and luxury conversions.
Available in five diameters from Ø 130 mm to Ø 250 mm to suit different roof openings and ventilators.
features: Suitable for commercial vehicles, horse trucks, boats and public vehicles

products.name: ABS Grille Small Ø 140 mm
products.tagline: Clean finish for the Exhaust Ventilator
products.summary: Ø 140 mm ABS interior grille in white, light grey or black. The neat, fixed interior cover for the 02-1030 exhaust ventilator. Custom colours on request.

products.summary: Ø 270 mm ABS honeycomb grille that covers the interior side of the Le Mans 02-2200 and Round 02-0200 ventilators. Fixed (non-closable) for unobstructed airflow and a safe finger guard. White, light grey or black.
description: The large ABS grille gives the inside of your Le Mans or Round rooftop ventilator a clean, professional finish while leaving the full 850 m³/h airflow unobstructed. It cannot be closed; if you need to shut off the airflow, choose the V12 or Flower Power valve instead.
Choose white, light grey or black. Custom colours on request.
features: Ø 270 mm x 4 mm honeycomb grille

products.name: Speedcontrol 30-3004
products.tagline: 0 to 100% stepless control, waterproof housing
products.summary: Stepless speed controller for DC roof fans. Dial the Le Mans down for silent night ventilation or run it flat out on hot days. 25 A continuous, waterproof housing, one unit can drive several ventilators.
description: The Speedcontrol lets you run any of our DC roof fans at exactly the speed you need: from a silent trickle to full power. The range is stepless from 0 to 100%, and at the zero position the unit draws no current at all.

Rated for 11 to 30 VDC and 25 A continuous (30 A peak), it works on 12V and 24V systems and can control one or several ventilators at once. The housing is waterproof, the unit is current-limited and transient-suppressed, and it connects with standard 6.3 mm flat connectors. Supplied with potentiometer knob and instructions.

specs.Housing: 80 x 60 x 20 mm (30 mm incl. connectors), waterproof

faq.q: Can I use it together with a 3-way switch?
faq.a: Yes. The switch selects blow / off / suck, the Speedcontrol sets the speed. The slower the fan runs, the quieter it is and the less air it moves.

products.name: 3-Way Switch Round 89-4002
products.tagline: On-Off-On, round built-in model
products.summary: Round double-changeover rocker switch (on-off-on) to switch your Le Mans, Round ventilator or Winglet between intake, off and exhaust. Presses into a Ø 20 mm dashboard hole.
description: The round 3-position switch for our rooftop ventilators. Flick up for intake, down for exhaust, centre for off. It is a double-changeover switch that reverses the motor, so you get both directions from a single control.

Suitable for most vehicles: it presses into a round dashboard hole or a prepared switch holder. Check the mounting hole dimensions in the datasheet before ordering. Combine with the Speedcontrol for stepless speed adjustment.

Works with Le Mans, Le Mans LL, Round and Winglet

description: The square 3-position switch for our rooftop ventilators. Up for intake, down for exhaust, centre off. Double changeover, so one switch reverses the motor.
A square built-in model for most vehicles; it presses into a prepared holder or rectangular cut-out (dimensions in the datasheet). Add the Speedcontrol to make the fan run steplessly from 0 to 100%.
features: Works with Le Mans, Le Mans LL, Round and Winglet

products.tagline: Illuminated rocker with ventilation symbols
products.summary: Premium rectangular 3-way rocker switch with ventilation symbol and red / amber illumination. The dashboard-grade control for Le Mans, Le Mans LL, Round and Winglet ventilators. 25 A 12V / 15 A 24V.

It is a double-changeover switch that reverses the motor, suitable for 12V (25 A) and 24V (15 A) systems. It presses into a standard rectangular holder; check the cut-out dimensions in the datasheet. Combine with the Speedcontrol for stepless airflow.

products.name: Roof Hatch Control Unit 30-6000
products.tagline: Controls one or two electric roof hatches
products.summary: The 24V control panel for our electric roof hatches. Opens and closes the front and rear of one or two hatches, shows dome position on green LEDs, auto-closes when the ignition goes off, and still allows ventilation when parked.
description: Always use the 30-6000 with our electric roof hatches. This compact 24V control unit manages one or two hatches: open or close the front and rear side independently, and read the dome position on the green LED display.

Safety and comfort are built in. The unit closes the hatches automatically when the ignition key is turned off, but the hatch can still be opened for ventilation while parked. The display has a current-save function and the push buttons are illuminated with orange LEDs for operation in the dark.
EMC approved and homologated according to EC 2004/104. For 12V vehicles, use our 12V to 24V converter (89-STEP12-24, on request).
features: Open/close front and rear side separately
Auto-close when ignition is switched off
Ventilation position available with ignition off

faq.q: Do I need one unit per hatch?
faq.a: No. One 30-6000 controls one or two electric roof hatches.

faq.q: My vehicle is 12V. Can I use it?
faq.a: Yes, with the 89-STEP12-24 converter. Contact us and we add it to your order.

products.name: Floor Ventilator Ø 129 mm
products.tagline: Closes the loop: fresh air in, low gases out
products.summary: Black PC/ABS floor ventilator for the loading floor. Removes low-hanging gases and boosts the capacity of your roof fan by giving it an inlet. Essential for gas bottles, dogs, horses and oil-containing goods.
description: A roof fan can only extract what it can replace. The floor ventilator gives your vehicle a low air inlet so the roof fan works at full capacity and a constant flow runs from floor to roof. At the same time it removes heavy, low-hanging gases. Mount it diagonally opposite the roof ventilator for the best cross-flow.

Made from tough PC/ABS with a Ø 129 mm cut-out (Ø 169 mm flange, 90 mm deep), it is the standard recommendation with every mechanical or electric rooftop ventilator. Particularly suitable when transporting gas bottles, dogs, animals and oil-containing products, and for meeting the ventilation guidance for gas cylinders in closed vans.
features: Cut-out Ø 129 mm, flange Ø 169 mm, 90 mm deep
For loading floors of vans and trailers

products.name: Floor Ventilator Ø 80 mm
products.tagline: Compact inlet for small vehicles
products.summary: The compact 80 mm floor ventilator. Same double function as the 129 mm model (gas removal and roof-fan boost) in a smaller footprint for small vans, dog boxes and compartments.
description: The 80 mm floor ventilator brings the same logic to small vehicles: create a low inlet so your Winglet, Turbo III or exhaust ventilator can actually move air, and let heavy gases escape at floor level.
PC/ABS, black RAL 9005, Ø 80 mm cut-out, Ø 119 mm outer, 90 mm deep, 0.4 kg. Recommended with any mechanical or electric rooftop ventilator.
features: Ideal for small vans and dog boxes

products.name: Snow Filter 89-5011
products.tagline: Keeps snow, insects and the last raindrops out
products.summary: Coarse-mesh carbon filter strip (860 x 40 x 10 mm) that fits inside the Le Mans and Round rooftop ventilators. Blocks snowflakes, insects and residual rain without choking the airflow.
description: Our roof ventilators are built so that virtually no rainwater enters the vehicle, but in snow, heavy weather or insect season a filter is the final safeguard. The snow filter is a medium, coarse-mesh net of carbon-infused polymer that shields the intake while leaving the airflow almost untouched.
The 89-5011 fits the 02-0200/0300 Round and 02-2200/2300 Le Mans ventilators. Recommended for vehicles operating in regions where snow can be drawn into the air intake.
features: Blocks snow, insects and residual rain

description: Our small roof hatch brings daylight, ventilation and privacy to minibuses, horse trucks, ambulances and campers. The dark tinted glass dome is homologated ECE 43R (UV transmission 6%, heat 16%, light 17%), and the hatch is homologated according to EC 2004/104.

The internal frame mounts easily inside the outside frame, which comes pre-drilled with mounting holes (outer frame 640 x 640 mm, 40 mm high; screw or bond). High-quality gaskets keep wind and water out. Suits roof thicknesses from 30 to 70 mm.
Need automation? The same hatch is available as an electric version (90-5000-E).

products.name: Axial Ventilator
products.tagline: Radiator cooling fans and blower assemblies
products.summary: Axial fans move air in a straight line, like an aircraft propeller. We supply blower motor assemblies, radiator cooling fans and spare parts for aftermarket automotive, heavy-duty truck, off-road and bus applications. Configured to your specification.
description: Axial fans contain a rotating shaft with propeller-style blades that pull air in on one side and push it out the other, creating a flow parallel to the fan axis. We supply a wide range of axial products for automotive climate systems: blower motor assemblies, radiator cooling fans and spare parts.
Widely used in aftermarket automotive, heavy-duty trucks, off-road machinery and buses. Different models, diameters and motors are available; tell us your application and we configure the right fan.

products.name: Radial Ventilator
products.tagline: Centrifugal blowers for ducted systems
products.summary: Radial (centrifugal) fans draw air in axially and blow it out at 90 degrees, ideal for moving air through ducts and restricted openings in HVAC systems, buses and specialty vehicles. Configured to your specification.
description: A radial fan, also known as a centrifugal fan, sucks air in axially and blows it out through a 90 degree bend on the radial axis, from the centre outwards. This makes it the right choice where air has to be pushed through ducts, pipes or restricted openings.

We supply single and double radial blowers with a wide choice of electric motors, IP68 protection and EMC approval. Tell us your airflow, voltage and space envelope and we will quote the matching unit.
features: IP68 protected, high efficiency, long life

products.name: Auto Ventilator 12/24V
products.tagline: Compact cabin fan, 1 or 2 speeds
products.summary: A compact cabin fan for cars, campers, caravans and boats. 12V or 24V, 1 or 2 speeds, with or without switch, with or without protective grid. Configured to your preference.
description: Our auto ventilator is the classic swivel cabin fan, built properly. Choose 12V or 24V, one or two speeds, with or without an integrated switch, and with or without a protective grid.
Compact and efficient, it is the ideal companion in a car, camper, caravan or boat cabin. Available on request; tell us your configuration and we quote within 24 hours.
features: EMC approved, different models and dimensions

products.name: Ceilingflow Ceiling Fan
products.tagline: Plug & play ceiling fan for suspended ceilings
products.summary: The professional ceiling fan that drops into a standard 600 x 600 suspended-ceiling tile. 130 m³/min, 27 to 41 W, 35 to 47 dB(A), remote control included. Cools in summer, destratifies heat in winter. Black or white.
description: Ceilingflow is the plug-and-play ceiling fan for offices, workshops, showrooms, shops, schools, kitchens, meeting rooms and server rooms. Remove a ceiling tile, insert the Ceilingflow (595 x 595 x 166 mm, 5.5 kg), plug it in and play. No installation costs, no installer, under five minutes.

With 130 m³/min of airflow at only 27 to 41 W and a noise level of 35 to 47 dB(A), it cools on warm days and pushes warm air back down on cold days, making optimal use of the vertical temperature profile of your heating. Three speeds, reversible direction and timer on the RF remote. Brushless motor with short-circuit and peak-voltage protection, recyclable ABS, RoHS, CE and LVD certified, IP44.
Remote control included (can also be operated without). Frame for solid ceilings available separately. One unit covers roughly 40 to 50 m².
features: Fits standard 600 x 600 suspended ceiling tile
RF remote control included (speed, direction, timer)

products.name: HEPA Air Purifier Small (8 to 15 m²)
products.tagline: H13 HEPA + carbon, 27 dB sleep mode
products.summary: Compact dark grey air purifier for workstations, bedrooms and small rooms. H13 HEPA + activated carbon filter, CADR 125 m³/h, 360° bottom intake, 3 speeds from 27 dB. Plug & play.
description: The 24-0125 is perfect for individual workstations, bedrooms and other areas with limited floor space. The 360° bottom air inlet and top outlet pull polluted air through an H13 HEPA and activated carbon filter and return clean air to the room.
CADR 125 m³/h (PM), TVOC CADR 40 to 60 m³/h, three speeds from a whisper-quiet 27 dB. 25 W, child lock, 1.8 kg, sleek matt dark grey.

products.name: HEPA Air Purifier Large (42 to 74 m²)
products.tagline: 600 m³/h CADR, anion, remote control
products.summary: High-capacity air purifier for meeting rooms, lobbies and open-plan offices. H13 HEPA + activated carbon + anion, CADR 600 m³/h, 6 speeds from 32.9 dB sleep mode, remote control, universal wheels.
description: The 24-0600 is ideal for large spaces where high-capacity filtration is required: meeting rooms, lobbies, open-plan offices, classrooms. H13 HEPA, activated carbon and an anion purifier (10 million/cm³) tackle fine dust, bacteria, viruses, dust mites, mould, pollen and odours.

PM CADR 600 m³/h, TVOC CADR 200 to 390 m³/h, six speeds from a 32.9 dB sleep mode, filter replacement reminder, child lock and a remote control that works from up to 5 metres. Matt grey, universal wheels, 10.5 kg.
features: H13 HEPA + activated carbon + anion purifier
6 speeds: 32.9 dB sleep mode to 69.5 dB
Universal wheels, 10.5 kg, 479 x 269 x 710 mm
